newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Siamese babies found abandoned in Pakistani city.
newsitem.headline: Siamese babies found abandoned in Pakistani city.

text.p: New-born siamese babies with only one head were abandoned at the office of a social work organisation in the southern Pakistani city of Hyderabad on Wednesday, the Edhi Welfare Foundation said.
The siamese, a boy and girl, were left in front of the Edhi Centre in Hyderabad in the southern province of Sindh, an Edhi spokesman said.
"The siamese, joined together from the abdoman and chest, have four legs, four arms, but only one head," he said.
"They have been brought to Karachi and will be shown to medical experts in the morning if they survive," he said.
